title: OpenCampus · UO Eugene
description: Explore a stylized UO campus with photo-informed landmarks and softly veiled low-poly surroundings.
source_description: Oregon DOGAMI / NOAA Digital Coast. Historical survey: 2008-08-31. Nine source tiles cover the main campus and surrounding context.
about_summary: Five photo-informed landmarks include Knight Library, EMU, Johnson Hall, Gerlinger Hall and Gerlinger Annex. All 534 historical building records have stylized appearance: 135 in the campus art-priority region and 399 in the background. Seeded low-poly archetypes retain source positions and footprints. There are 600 illustrative trees; 300 pilot trees use archived 2024 NAIP cues and 300 additional trees are procedurally inferred.
about_limitations: This is a recognizable first-pass art model, refined through long-term correction. Facade dimensions, hidden sides, roof details and tree heights/species include plausible inference. The aerial image guides illustrative canopy distribution, not surveyed individual trees. Photos span different years; EMU combines historical and later design motifs. No new field measurements or photogrammetric solve were performed. Base terrain/roof candidates retain 2008 provenance; Census roads have estimated widths. Stairs, terraces and planting are decorative, not a surveyed navigation mesh. The square extent is not a property boundary. The art-priority polygon is not an official campus boundary. Background archetypes, roof forms and palettes are illustrative, not identified real building types. Extra campus trees/lawns are inferred, not extracted from new aerial imagery. Background haze is a visual effect and does not change the exported geographic geometry.

project_description: Open Campus: UO develops this campus model and viewer. Its public upstream pipeline develops reusable reconstruction methods, automation and the browser template. Additional maps can build on the same template.
footer: Independent reconstruction project. No University of Oregon endorsement. Public development preview.
